simulation.subject: URGENT: Your password expires today! Update now!!!
simulation.body:
Dear User,

Your network password will expire in 2 hours! If you dont change it right now your account will be locked forever and you will lose access to all IT systems!

Click here immediately to reset your password: [SIMULATED LINK: Password Reset Portal]

Thanks,
The IT Team

metadata.difficulty_rationale: The email includes glaring red flags such as excessive exclamation marks, a generic greeting, a suspicious external domain, and extreme urgency.
metadata.scenario_notes: Designed as a Level 1 difficulty training example for IT staff awareness.

semantic_findings: The body text contains grammatical mistakes such as 'dont' instead of 'don't', which degrades overall realism for a professional tech firm context.

The threat that the account will be 'locked forever' is overly dramatic and uncharacteristic of standard IT password expiration warnings.
